title: Can Jacksonville’s Defense Repeat Without Devin Lloyd?

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Can Jacksonville’s Defense Repeat Without Devin Lloyd?
sources.description: From an 8-1 record when winning the turnover battle, the 2026 Jacksonville Jaguars' defensive identity starts and ends with one core question: can Campanile's unit continue to force turnovers at an elite level, following the loss of a game changing talent?
